claims.statement: The OpenWiki serves as a comprehensive documentation platform designed for the MakersLounge v2 project, focusing on a community directory product underpinned by a private signal, public surface principle.
The Quickstart section offers users a structured onboarding pathway through key documentation topics including the domain model, implementation structure, import workflows, and testing strategies.
The OpenWiki documentation provides a repository map that links to architecturally significant, domain-specific, operational, and workflow-related pages.
As of the latest documentation, the codebase is mainly documentation-led, with strategic design specifications guiding future implementation work.
